incidents.name: Market.xyz read-only reentrancy on Curve LP pricing
incidents.notes: The market priced its Curve/Beefy LP collateral with get_virtual_price read while a Curve remove_liquidity call was mid-execution, so re-entering from the native-token callback let the attacker borrow miMATIC against a collateral valuation that the pool's own transient state had inflated.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x3dC7E6FF0fB79770FA6FB05d1ea4deACCe823943 created 2022-09-16T09:26:19Z by 0x906206149e9614c37077d62bb8cbbb3b8b203175, not the attack-tx sender 0x4206d62305d2815494dcdb759c4e32fca1d181a0; no EIP-1967 events, 37.5 days old. Reported loss $180k. Recheck (deployment basis confirmed): the victim is a Fuse CErc20Delegator whose `implementation` occupies the low 20 bytes of storage slot 0. Binary-searching eth_getStorageAt on slot 0 over [33172698, 34716800] shows it held 0xb6622fe99121bf83df5c172344ed382b894482c5 for the whole pre-incident life - the only address the victim delegatecalls in the exploit trace - and keccak(eth_getCode) on the delegator is identical at the creation and incident blocks.
